description: I’m a 10th grade high school student. I’m skilled at critical thinking when it comes to connecting concepts and I’m able to make them  beneficial and useful. I’m interested in  making a monitoring  health software design to help make healthcare more beneficial to astronauts on space missions. Teammates in this project are required to be innovative and capable of connecting ideas and concepts, as well as having the ability to connect them through creative software designs, program, etc.
summary:
PULSE X is an interactive astronaut health-monitoring software designed to support astronauts during long-duration space missions. It provides a dashboard that brings important health indicators together, including cardiovascular activity, bone health, immune-system status, radiation exposure, and mental wellbeing.

The software features an animated ECG graph and changing heart-rate readings, as well as an interactive mental-wellbeing assessment where users can select emotions such as calm, anxious, stressed, or tired. Based on their selections, the system displays simulated heart-rate responses and helpful recommendations. It also includes health-monitoring sections and a health-report feature.

PULSE X addresses the challenge of helping astronauts recognize and evaluate potential health changes while living in space, where microgravity, radiation, isolation, and confinement can affect their wellbeing. This project is important because early awareness and regular health monitoring can support better decisions, encourage healthy habits, and contribute to safer, longer space missions.
details: PULSE X is an interactive astronaut health-monitoring software that tracks simulated health indicators such as heart rate, bone health, immune status, radiation exposure, and mental wellbeing. It features an animated ECG graph, interactive mood assessments, and personalized recommendations to help astronauts evaluate their health. Its goal is to support healthier and safer space missions by encouraging early awareness of potential health changes. The project was developed using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with W3Schools and ChatGPT as development resources. Its creative design combines physical and mental health monitoring in one easy-to-use dashboard.
